# Plotly.js

The locally bundled `plotly.min.js` is Plotly.js 3.0.1 from
https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-3.0.1.min.js. Plotly.js is MIT licensed; its copyright and
license notice are included in the library header. No CDN connection is needed
when viewing charts. The SHA-256 of the downloaded asset is recorded in
`vendor_manifest.json`.
